questions.question_text: Two satellites orbit the same planet in circular orbits of radii r and 4r. What is the ratio of their orbital speeds (inner:outer)?
questions.explanation: For a circular orbit, v = sqrt(GM/r); increasing orbital radius fourfold halves the orbital speed.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual verification: NCERT Science, Gravitation, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php
